BETA Close X Drax Group PLC has executed a share buyback, purchasing 72,200 ordinary shares on April 2, 2026, at prices ranging from 884.50 pence to 897.00 pence, with a volume-weighted average price of 892.7212 pence. This transaction, part of a program announced on July 31, 2025, brings the total shares purchased for treasury to 9,077,902. Following this, Drax Group has 432,461,089 ordinary shares in issue, with 336,334,591 representing voting rights. Disclaimer* Drax Group PLC 07 April 2026 7 April 2026 Drax Group plc Transactions in own shares Drax Group plc (Drax Group) announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the "Programme") announced on 31 July 2025, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 11 16/29 pence each (Ordinary Shares) on the London Stock Exchange through J.P. Morgan Securities plc. Date of purchase: 2 April 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 72,200 Lowest price paid per ordinary share (p): 884.5000 Highest price paid per ordinary share (p): 897.0000 Volume weighted average price paid per share (p): 892.7212 Following the above transaction, Drax Group will have 432,461,089 Ordinary Shares in issue, including treasury shares. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 96,126,498. The total number of voting rights in Drax Group, excluding treasury shares as at 2 April 2026 is 336,334,591. This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Drax Group under the FCA's Disclosure and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 31 July 2025, Drax Group has purchased 9,077,902 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for treasury.
